Recorded claim:
Commit a5d51b060bc16f2f1410cc2db60a3141ac2476b2 wraps a test's deliberate mouse click on an inert banner summary with `AccessibilityUtils.suppressClickHandling(true)` and restores the check in `finally`. This applies to that mouse-only no-op test; it does not establish a rule for interactive summary clicks or other tests.

Provenance: 40759be9e2fd172d9bc3770d683d385ae38ca66d58d80e045be430bd497c6927. Original evidence IDs: 226b3383fe98c62b5187aea911aceec7f5b5eedbd5c162b414a8063a92b6dc1a.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
Source references:
https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/a5d51b060bc16f2f1410cc2db60a3141ac2476b2
title: Recorded lesson: Suppress the inert banner click check
